tasks.bundle: deno bundle --platform browser -c deno.json ./client/register-store.ts -o ./public/register-store.js && deno bundle --platform browser -c deno.json ./client/role-pages-lib.ts -o ./public/role-pages-lib.js && deno bundle --platform browser -c deno.json ./client/solid-auth.ts -o ./public/solid-auth.js && deno bundle --platform browser -c deno.json ./client/solid-pod.ts -o ./public/solid-pod.js && sed -i -e 's|from "node:buffer"|from "data:text/javascript,export var Buffer=globalThis.Buffer"|g' -e 's|import { Buffer as Buffer2 } from "node:buffer";|var Buffer2 = require_buffer().Buffer;|g' -e 's|__require("node:buffer")|require_buffer()|g' -e 's|__require("node:events")|require_events()|g' public/solid-auth.js public/solid-pod.js
tasks.start: deno task bundle && deno task serve
